item.title: Meshery Server Registration
item.description: Layer5 Cloud is a Meshery remote provider. When a Meshery Server uses Layer5 Cloud, hosted or self-hosted, the server registers itself with Cloud on behalf of the signed-in user. Registration is what makes that Meshery Server known to Cloud: it appears as a meshery connection owned by that user. This page explains what the server sends, how Cloud tells a new server from one it already knows, what survives re-registration, and what each failure means.
